# Scheduled task compatibility fixtures

These fixtures freeze the persisted shapes read and written by the `v2.5.0`
and `v3.0.6` tags: extension settings plus `LittleWhiteBox_Tasks.json`, the
`xiaobaix-tasks` character extension, `xiaobai_ext.scheduledTasks` in preset
prompt order entry `100000`, and the public import/export envelope. Values are
representative and contain no user data; field placement and names come from
the tagged implementations.
